en.text: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. The starting postulate assigns the identity operator value 1 in the state. We follow that preserved identity.

translations.en: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. The starting postulate assigns the identity operator value 1 in the state. We follow that preserved identity.
translations.fr: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. Le postulat initial attribue la valeur 1 à l’opérateur identité dans l’état. Nous suivons cette identité préservée.
translations.pt-BR: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. O postulado inicial atribui valor 1 ao operador identidade no estado. Seguimos essa identidade preservada.
translations.zh-Hans: 光动力学引力理论。起始公设规定：恒等算符在该状态中的值为 1。接下来追踪这一保持不变的恒等性。

en.text: This geometry illustrates an ontological reading; the cosmic setting serves the presentation. Now the boundary takes shape.

translations.en: This geometry illustrates an ontological reading; the cosmic setting serves the presentation. Now the boundary takes shape.
translations.fr: Cette géométrie illustre une lecture ontologique ; le décor cosmique sert la présentation. La frontière prend maintenant forme.
translations.pt-BR: Esta geometria ilustra uma leitura ontológica; o cenário cósmico serve à apresentação. Agora a fronteira toma forma.
translations.zh-Hans: 这里的几何呈现一种本体论解读；宇宙背景用于展示。现在，边界开始成形。

en.text: Self-conjugacy makes the boundary its own complement. Its fixed point is 0.5.

translations.en: Self-conjugacy makes the boundary its own complement. Its fixed point is 0.5.
translations.fr: L’autoconjugaison fait de la frontière son propre complément. Son point fixe vaut 0,5.
translations.pt-BR: A autoconjugação torna a fronteira seu próprio complemento. Seu ponto fixo é 0,5.
translations.zh-Hans: 自共轭使边界成为自身的补集。不动点为 0.5。

en.text: Here, boundary entropy is 0.5 nat. Exponentiating it gives the minimum volume: the square root of Euler’s number.

translations.en: Here, boundary entropy is 0.5 nat. Exponentiating it gives the minimum volume: the square root of Euler’s number.
translations.fr: Ici, l’entropie de frontière vaut 0,5 nat. Son exponentielle donne le volume minimal : la racine carrée du nombre d’Euler.
translations.pt-BR: Aqui, a entropia da fronteira é 0,5 nat. A exponencial desse valor dá o volume mínimo: a raiz quadrada do número de Euler.
translations.zh-Hans: 这里，边界熵为 0.5 纳特。对它取指数，得到最小体积：欧拉数的平方根。

en.text: The fine-structure constant, supplied externally, multiplies the entropic factor—the square root of Euler’s number—giving the TGL coupling rate, beta TGL.

translations.en: The fine-structure constant, supplied externally, multiplies the entropic factor—the square root of Euler’s number—giving the TGL coupling rate, beta TGL.
translations.fr: La constante de structure fine, fournie extérieurement, multiplie le facteur entropique — la racine carrée du nombre d’Euler — et donne le taux de couplage TGL, bêta TGL.
translations.pt-BR: A constante da estrutura fina, fornecida externamente, multiplica o radical entrópico — a raiz quadrada do número de Euler —, dando a taxa de acoplamento beta TGL.
translations.zh-Hans: 精细结构常数作为外部输入，乘以熵因子——欧拉数的平方根——给出 TGL 耦合率，即 beta TGL。

en.text: It sets the reflected share; transmission carries the rest. The projection angle is 6.3 degrees.

translations.en: It sets the reflected share; transmission carries the rest. The projection angle is 6.3 degrees.
translations.fr: Il fixe la part réfléchie ; la transmission porte le reste. L’angle de projection vaut 6,3 degrés.
translations.pt-BR: Ela fixa a parcela refletida; a transmissão leva o restante. O ângulo de projeção é 6,3 graus.
translations.zh-Hans: 它确定反射份额，其余部分透射。投影角为 6.3 度。

en.text: The modular flow acts along the hyperbolic face. Its changing weights are read through the compact projection angle.

translations.en: The modular flow acts along the hyperbolic face. Its changing weights are read through the compact projection angle.
translations.fr: Le flot modulaire agit sur la face hyperbolique. Ses poids changeants sont lus par l’angle compact de projection.
translations.pt-BR: O fluxo modular atua na face hiperbólica. Seus pesos em mudança são lidos pelo ângulo compacto da projeção.
translations.zh-Hans: 模流作用于双曲面。变化的权重由紧致投影角读取。

en.text: Powers links the scales. The density distributes the zero mode’s weight, separated from the other modes by Breuer’s local gap.

translations.en: Powers links the scales. The density distributes the zero mode’s weight, separated from the other modes by Breuer’s local gap.
translations.fr: Powers relie les échelles. La densité répartit le poids du mode zéro, séparé des autres modes par le gap local de Breuer.
translations.pt-BR: Powers liga as escalas. A densidade distribui o peso do modo zero, separado dos demais pelo gap local de Breuer.
translations.zh-Hans: Powers 阶梯连接不同尺度。密度分布描述零模的权重；Breuer 局部谱隙将它与其他模分开。

en.text: Applying the reflection operation twice restores identity. Conjugation reverses the generator, so the displayed gradient reverses direction.

translations.en: Applying the reflection operation twice restores identity. Conjugation reverses the generator, so the displayed gradient reverses direction.
translations.fr: Appliquer deux fois l’opération de réflexion rétablit l’identité. La conjugaison inverse le générateur : le gradient affiché change donc de sens.
translations.pt-BR: Aplicar a operação de reflexão duas vezes restaura a identidade. A conjugação inverte o gerador; assim, o gradiente exibido muda de sentido.
translations.zh-Hans: 连续施加两次反射操作会恢复恒等作用。共轭使生成元反号，因此画面中的梯度方向反转。

en.text: The amber return makes the reflected share visible: a return among 83 rays. The remaining share continues through the mirror.

translations.en: The amber return makes the reflected share visible: a return among 83 rays. The remaining share continues through the mirror.
translations.fr: Le retour ambré rend visible la part réfléchie : un retour parmi 83 rayons. La part restante traverse le miroir.
translations.pt-BR: O retorno âmbar torna visível a parcela refletida: um retorno entre 83 raios. A parcela restante atravessa o espelho.
translations.zh-Hans: 琥珀色返回显现反射份额：每 83 条光线中一次返回。其余份额穿过镜面。

en.text: Soldering connects the local frame to transport. Changing the order leaves a rotation; a small loop reveals curvature.

translations.en: Soldering connects the local frame to transport. Changing the order leaves a rotation; a small loop reveals curvature.
translations.fr: La soudure relie le repère local au transport. Changer l’ordre laisse une rotation ; un petit circuit révèle la courbure.
translations.pt-BR: A solda liga o referencial local ao transporte. Mudar a ordem deixa uma rotação; um pequeno circuito revela a curvatura.
translations.zh-Hans: 焊接把局部标架与输运连接起来。交换顺序会留下旋转；沿小回路输运则显出曲率。

en.text: The throat follows the static Schwarzschild geometry. The rotating helix shows 2 polarizations carried by the tensor.

translations.en: The throat follows the static Schwarzschild geometry. The rotating helix shows 2 polarizations carried by the tensor.
translations.fr: La gorge suit la géométrie statique de Schwarzschild. L’hélice tournante montre 2 polarisations portées par le tenseur.
translations.pt-BR: A garganta acompanha a geometria estática de Schwarzschild. A hélice em rotação mostra 2 polarizações carregadas pelo tensor.
translations.zh-Hans: 喉部跟随史瓦西静态几何。旋转的螺旋显示张量携带的 2 个偏振。

en.text: In the Pentad, assume finite trace of the kernel projection and a local spectral gap; the coframe organizes Lorentz directions; Clausius links heat and horizon area.

translations.en: In the Pentad, assume finite trace of the kernel projection and a local spectral gap; the coframe organizes Lorentz directions; Clausius links heat and horizon area.
translations.fr: Dans la Pentade, nous supposons une trace finie de la projection sur le noyau et un gap spectral local ; le corepère organise les directions de Lorentz ; Clausius relie chaleur et aire de l’horizon.
translations.pt-BR: Na Pêntada, supomos traço finito da projeção sobre o núcleo e gap espectral local; o coframe organiza direções de Lorentz; Clausius liga calor e área no horizonte.
translations.zh-Hans: 在五元组中，假设核投影的迹有限，并存在局部谱隙；余标架组织洛伦兹方向；克劳修斯关系连接视界的热量与面积。

en.text: The horizon relation yields Einstein’s coefficient in the kernel. The gate has 15 calculated and 3 literal flags.

translations.en: The horizon relation yields Einstein’s coefficient in the kernel. The gate has 15 calculated and 3 literal flags.
translations.fr: La relation à l’horizon donne le coefficient d’Einstein dans le noyau. La porte compte 15 indicateurs calculés et 3 littéraux.
translations.pt-BR: A relação no horizonte dá o coeficiente de Einstein no kernel. O gate tem 15 bandeiras calculadas e 3 literais.
translations.zh-Hans: 视界关系在内核中给出爱因斯坦系数。门控包含 15 个计算标志和 3 个字面标志。

en.text: Identity returns with residual 0. The proof ladder now displays 9679 ladder flags (named declarations), all clean.

translations.en: Identity returns with residual 0. The proof ladder now displays 9679 ladder flags (named declarations), all clean.
translations.fr: L’identité revient avec un résidu de 0. L’échelle de preuve affiche 9679 marqueurs de l’échelle (déclarations nommées), tous propres.
translations.pt-BR: A identidade retorna com resíduo 0. A escada de prova exibe 9679 bandeiras da escada (declarações nomeadas), todas limpas.
translations.zh-Hans: 恒等返回的残差为 0。证明阶梯显示 9679 个阶梯标志（具名声明），全部干净。

en.text: The path closes where it began: the same identity survives the mirror, transport and curvature. The screen then turns to the test.

translations.en: The path closes where it began: the same identity survives the mirror, transport and curvature. The screen then turns to the test.
translations.fr: Le parcours se ferme à son origine : la même identité traverse miroir, transport et courbure. L’écran passe alors au test.
translations.pt-BR: O percurso fecha onde começou: a mesma identidade atravessa espelho, transporte e curvatura. A tela passa então ao teste.
translations.zh-Hans: 路径在起点闭合：同一恒等性经过镜面、输运与曲率而保持。画面随后转向检验。

en.text: The three supports count together, each with its own status: calibrated separation 4.44, one-sided probability 0.00000443, threshold 5 sigma. The result remains below it.

translations.en: The three supports count together, each with its own status: calibrated separation 4.44, one-sided probability 0.00000443, threshold 5 sigma. The result remains below it.
translations.fr: Les trois appuis comptent ensemble, chacun avec son propre statut : séparation calibrée 4,44, probabilité unilatérale 0,00000443, seuil 5 sigma. Le résultat reste en dessous.
translations.pt-BR: Os três apoios contam juntos, cada um com o seu estatuto: separação calibrada 4,44, probabilidade unilateral 0,00000443, limiar 5 sigma. O resultado permanece abaixo dele.
translations.zh-Hans: 三个支撑共同发挥作用，各自保有其地位：校准后的区分度为 4.44，单侧概率为 0.00000443，阈值为 5 sigma。结果仍低于阈值。

en.text: The model’s offset is -1.48: not falsified with power. Bayesian evidence uses another scale. Kernel validity holds under hypotheses; nature decides.

translations.en: The model’s offset is -1.48: not falsified with power. Bayesian evidence uses another scale. Kernel validity holds under hypotheses; nature decides.
translations.fr: L’écart du modèle vaut -1,48 : non falsifiée avec puissance. L’évidence bayésienne utilise une autre échelle. Validité dans le noyau sous hypothèses ; la nature tranche.
translations.pt-BR: O desvio do modelo é -1,48: não falsificada com poder. Evidência bayesiana usa outra escala. Validade no kernel sob hipóteses; a natureza decide.
translations.zh-Hans: 模型偏差为 -1.48：在有检验功效的条件下未被证伪。贝叶斯证据采用另一种尺度。内核有效性成立于假设之下；自然裁决。

pt-BR.text: O desvio do modelo é -1,48: não falsificada com poder. Evidência bayesiana usa outra escala. Validade no kernel sob hipóteses; a natureza decide.

translations.en: The model’s offset is -1.48: not falsified with power. Bayesian evidence uses another scale. Kernel validity holds under hypotheses; nature decides.
translations.fr: L’écart du modèle vaut -1,48 : non falsifiée avec puissance. L’évidence bayésienne utilise une autre échelle. Validité dans le noyau sous hypothèses ; la nature tranche.
translations.pt-BR: O desvio do modelo é -1,48: não falsificada com poder. Evidência bayesiana usa outra escala. Validade no kernel sob hipóteses; a natureza decide.
translations.zh-Hans: 模型偏差为 -1.48：在有检验功效的条件下未被证伪。贝叶斯证据采用另一种尺度。内核有效性成立于假设之下；自然裁决。

cues.en: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. The starting postulate assigns the identity operator value 1 in the state. We follow that preserved identity.
cues.fr: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. Le postulat initial attribue la valeur 1 à l’opérateur identité dans l’état. Nous suivons cette identité préservée.
cues.pt-BR: Teoria da Gravitação Luminodinâmica. O postulado inicial atribui valor 1 ao operador identidade no estado. Seguimos essa identidade preservada.
cues.zh-Hans: 光动力学引力理论。起始公设规定：恒等算符在该状态中的值为 1。接下来追踪这一保持不变的恒等性。

cues.en: This geometry illustrates an ontological reading; the cosmic setting serves the presentation. Now the boundary takes shape.
cues.fr: Cette géométrie illustre une lecture ontologique ; le décor cosmique sert la présentation. La frontière prend maintenant forme.
cues.pt-BR: Esta geometria ilustra uma leitura ontológica; o cenário cósmico serve à apresentação. Agora a fronteira toma forma.
cues.zh-Hans: 这里的几何呈现一种本体论解读；宇宙背景用于展示。现在，边界开始成形。

cues.en: Self-conjugacy makes the boundary its own complement. Its fixed point is 0.5.
cues.fr: L’autoconjugaison fait de la frontière son propre complément. Son point fixe vaut 0,5.
cues.pt-BR: A autoconjugação torna a fronteira seu próprio complemento. Seu ponto fixo é 0,5.
cues.zh-Hans: 自共轭使边界成为自身的补集。不动点为 0.5。

cues.en: Here, boundary entropy is 0.5 nat. Exponentiating it gives the minimum volume: the square root of Euler’s number.
cues.fr: Ici, l’entropie de frontière vaut 0,5 nat. Son exponentielle donne le volume minimal : la racine carrée du nombre d’Euler.
cues.pt-BR: Aqui, a entropia da fronteira é 0,5 nat. A exponencial desse valor dá o volume mínimo: a raiz quadrada do número de Euler.
cues.zh-Hans: 这里，边界熵为 0.5 纳特。对它取指数，得到最小体积：欧拉数的平方根。

cues.en: The fine-structure constant, supplied externally, multiplies the entropic factor—the square root of Euler’s number—giving the TGL coupling rate, beta TGL.
cues.fr: La constante de structure fine, fournie extérieurement, multiplie le facteur entropique — la racine carrée du nombre d’Euler — et donne le taux de couplage TGL, bêta TGL.
cues.pt-BR: A constante da estrutura fina, fornecida externamente, multiplica o radical entrópico — a raiz quadrada do número de Euler —, dando a taxa de acoplamento beta TGL.
cues.zh-Hans: 精细结构常数作为外部输入，乘以熵因子——欧拉数的平方根——给出 TGL 耦合率，即 beta TGL。

cues.en: It sets the reflected share; transmission carries the rest. The projection angle is 6.3 degrees.
cues.fr: Il fixe la part réfléchie ; la transmission porte le reste. L’angle de projection vaut 6,3 degrés.
cues.pt-BR: Ela fixa a parcela refletida; a transmissão leva o restante. O ângulo de projeção é 6,3 graus.
cues.zh-Hans: 它确定反射份额，其余部分透射。投影角为 6.3 度。

cues.en: The modular flow acts along the hyperbolic face. Its changing weights are read through the compact projection angle.
cues.fr: Le flot modulaire agit sur la face hyperbolique. Ses poids changeants sont lus par l’angle compact de projection.
cues.pt-BR: O fluxo modular atua na face hiperbólica. Seus pesos em mudança são lidos pelo ângulo compacto da projeção.
cues.zh-Hans: 模流作用于双曲面。变化的权重由紧致投影角读取。

cues.en: Powers links the scales. The density distributes the zero mode’s weight, separated from the other modes by Breuer’s local gap.
cues.fr: Powers relie les échelles. La densité répartit le poids du mode zéro, séparé des autres modes par le gap local de Breuer.
cues.pt-BR: Powers liga as escalas. A densidade distribui o peso do modo zero, separado dos demais pelo gap local de Breuer.
cues.zh-Hans: Powers 阶梯连接不同尺度。密度分布描述零模的权重；Breuer 局部谱隙将它与其他模分开。

cues.en: Applying the reflection operation twice restores identity. Conjugation reverses the generator, so the displayed gradient reverses direction.
cues.fr: Appliquer deux fois l’opération de réflexion rétablit l’identité. La conjugaison inverse le générateur : le gradient affiché change donc de sens.
cues.pt-BR: Aplicar a operação de reflexão duas vezes restaura a identidade. A conjugação inverte o gerador; assim, o gradiente exibido muda de sentido.
cues.zh-Hans: 连续施加两次反射操作会恢复恒等作用。共轭使生成元反号，因此画面中的梯度方向反转。

cues.en: The amber return makes the reflected share visible: a return among 83 rays. The remaining share continues through the mirror.
cues.fr: Le retour ambré rend visible la part réfléchie : un retour parmi 83 rayons. La part restante traverse le miroir.
cues.pt-BR: O retorno âmbar torna visível a parcela refletida: um retorno entre 83 raios. A parcela restante atravessa o espelho.
cues.zh-Hans: 琥珀色返回显现反射份额：每 83 条光线中一次返回。其余份额穿过镜面。

cues.en: Soldering connects the local frame to transport. Changing the order leaves a rotation; a small loop reveals curvature.
cues.fr: La soudure relie le repère local au transport. Changer l’ordre laisse une rotation ; un petit circuit révèle la courbure.
cues.pt-BR: A solda liga o referencial local ao transporte. Mudar a ordem deixa uma rotação; um pequeno circuito revela a curvatura.
cues.zh-Hans: 焊接把局部标架与输运连接起来。交换顺序会留下旋转；沿小回路输运则显出曲率。

cues.en: The throat follows the static Schwarzschild geometry. The rotating helix shows 2 polarizations carried by the tensor.
cues.fr: La gorge suit la géométrie statique de Schwarzschild. L’hélice tournante montre 2 polarisations portées par le tenseur.
cues.pt-BR: A garganta acompanha a geometria estática de Schwarzschild. A hélice em rotação mostra 2 polarizações carregadas pelo tensor.
cues.zh-Hans: 喉部跟随史瓦西静态几何。旋转的螺旋显示张量携带的 2 个偏振。

cues.en: In the Pentad, assume finite trace of the kernel projection and a local spectral gap; the coframe organizes Lorentz directions; Clausius links heat and horizon area.
cues.fr: Dans la Pentade, nous supposons une trace finie de la projection sur le noyau et un gap spectral local ; le corepère organise les directions de Lorentz ; Clausius relie chaleur et aire de l’horizon.
cues.pt-BR: Na Pêntada, supomos traço finito da projeção sobre o núcleo e gap espectral local; o coframe organiza direções de Lorentz; Clausius liga calor e área no horizonte.
cues.zh-Hans: 在五元组中，假设核投影的迹有限，并存在局部谱隙；余标架组织洛伦兹方向；克劳修斯关系连接视界的热量与面积。

cues.en: The horizon relation yields Einstein’s coefficient in the kernel. The gate has 15 calculated and 3 literal flags.
cues.fr: La relation à l’horizon donne le coefficient d’Einstein dans le noyau. La porte compte 15 indicateurs calculés et 3 littéraux.
cues.pt-BR: A relação no horizonte dá o coeficiente de Einstein no kernel. O gate tem 15 bandeiras calculadas e 3 literais.
cues.zh-Hans: 视界关系在内核中给出爱因斯坦系数。门控包含 15 个计算标志和 3 个字面标志。

cues.en: Identity returns with residual 0. The proof ladder now displays 9679 ladder flags (named declarations), all clean.
cues.fr: L’identité revient avec un résidu de 0. L’échelle de preuve affiche 9679 marqueurs de l’échelle (déclarations nommées), tous propres.
cues.pt-BR: A identidade retorna com resíduo 0. A escada de prova exibe 9679 bandeiras da escada (declarações nomeadas), todas limpas.
cues.zh-Hans: 恒等返回的残差为 0。证明阶梯显示 9679 个阶梯标志（具名声明），全部干净。

cues.en: The path closes where it began: the same identity survives the mirror, transport and curvature. The screen then turns to the test.
cues.fr: Le parcours se ferme à son origine : la même identité traverse miroir, transport et courbure. L’écran passe alors au test.
cues.pt-BR: O percurso fecha onde começou: a mesma identidade atravessa espelho, transporte e curvatura. A tela passa então ao teste.
cues.zh-Hans: 路径在起点闭合：同一恒等性经过镜面、输运与曲率而保持。画面随后转向检验。

cues.en: The three supports count together, each with its own status: calibrated separation 4.44, one-sided probability 0.00000443, threshold 5 sigma. The result remains below it.
cues.fr: Les trois appuis comptent ensemble, chacun avec son propre statut : séparation calibrée 4,44, probabilité unilatérale 0,00000443, seuil 5 sigma. Le résultat reste en dessous.
cues.pt-BR: Os três apoios contam juntos, cada um com o seu estatuto: separação calibrada 4,44, probabilidade unilateral 0,00000443, limiar 5 sigma. O resultado permanece abaixo dele.
cues.zh-Hans: 三个支撑共同发挥作用，各自保有其地位：校准后的区分度为 4.44，单侧概率为 0.00000443，阈值为 5 sigma。结果仍低于阈值。

cues.en: The model’s offset is -1.48: not falsified with power. Bayesian evidence uses another scale. Kernel validity holds under hypotheses; nature decides.
cues.fr: L’écart du modèle vaut -1,48 : non falsifiée avec puissance. L’évidence bayésienne utilise une autre échelle. Validité dans le noyau sous hypothèses ; la nature tranche.
cues.pt-BR: O desvio do modelo é -1,48: não falsificada com poder. Evidência bayesiana usa outra escala. Validade no kernel sob hipóteses; a natureza decide.
cues.zh-Hans: 模型偏差为 -1.48：在有检验功效的条件下未被证伪。贝叶斯证据采用另一种尺度。内核有效性成立于假设之下；自然裁决。
